requirements.text: Minimum A-level offer: A*A*A, including Mathematics. Some colleges also require Further Mathematics or set higher offers. All applicants must take TMUA. Check the chosen college’s rules. IB: 41–42 overall with 776 at Higher Level, including Mathematics; Analysis and Approaches is normally required.
requirements.pastEntrants: Among Cambridge Economics entrants with A levels in 2018, 2019, and 2023, 80% achieved at least A*A*A*. 93% had studied Further Mathematics. These figures cover different cohorts from the HESA points chart.
